decision: Keep existing validator repair cards as the default and keep deterministic evidence repair guidance disabled by default.
reason: Evidence-only and broad combined guidance regressed known successful repairs. Narrow combined guidance has not yet demonstrated incremental value under a frozen comparison.
reconsider_if: a frozen rejected-candidate replay shows higher repair convergence without lowering existing-card success
an actionable evidence delta recovers a validator-missed source omission on held-out cases
repair guidance can be evaluated with Stage-1 inventory and initial draft held identical
